email.subject: AI for Harter Secrest & Emery - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kristie,

With 120 attorneys across five offices and practice areas ranging from litigation to corporate to healthcare, Harter Secrest & Emery serves clients BigLaw would turn away. That scale and complexity is exactly where most legal tech fails.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-size practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your Rochester office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
